svg.title: Merge Sort
svg.desc: Merge Sort. Split the list until single items remain, then merge sorted halves back together: O(n log n) every time, and stable. Step 1, Split down to single items: Halve the array, then halve the halves, down to single items: no comparisons yet. Step 2, Merge back up: Merge neighbours into sorted pairs, then pairs into sorted fours: 10 comparisons so far. Step 3, One merge, close up: The smaller head moves up each time; on the 2a = 2b tie the left one goes first, so it is stable. Step 4, Always n log n: 3 levels of 8 moves each: 24 for any input, so the worst case stays O(n log n). Cost: n extra cells.

g.text: Halve the array, then halve the halves, down to single items: no comparisons yet.

The smaller head moves up each time; on the 2a = 2b tie the left one goes first, so it is stable.
3 levels of 8 moves each: 24 for any input, so the worst case stays O(n log n). Cost: n extra cells.
